title: nelsonia origanoides
intro: Nelsonia origanoides, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a plant species used in traditional Ayurvedic and Unani medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which may help alleviate various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Nelsonia origanoides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and modulate the immune system.
